title: HP Omnibook X Flip 16" 3K OLED Touch Laptop: Intel Ultra 7 258V CPU, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD $1614.15 Delivered @ HP eBay
body:
Deal: HP Omnibook X Flip 16" 3K OLED Touch Laptop: Intel Ultra 7 258V CPU, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD $1614.15 Delivered @ HP eBay

[Metre] Pretty sturdy build and for this price the specs
[happychappy1] looks like a plastic frame. not sure if I'd call it sturdy.
[Dunnomuch] It's not plastic, it's all aluminium chassis
[georgev] https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/930073
Looks similar. Just letting you know, the speaker sound quality is below average.
[utsc] I purchased the 14-inch model in March, and the speakers are already vibrating, even with very light use. I only use it occasionally as my secondary laptop.
Whenever a Windows error notification sound plays, there's a very noticeable vibration coming from the speakers.
It appears the speakers may already be starting to deteriorate. If the issue gets worse, I'll need to have them repaired or replaced under warranty.
[Raj09] Pleasure. 32gb at this price is pretty hard to find. Blame memory shortage.
[Geoffers] That cpu is dog poo fyi based on cpu ratings I'm looking at.. very very poor for $1600
[encryptededdy] Eh, it's fast enough for most use cases and it has (PC) segment leading iGPU (except Panther Lake X7/9) and power consumption
[encryptededdy] If you're not gaming you can drive any external monitor you want, although note lunar lake has a max of 2 external monitors + the internal.
[encryptededdy] Whilst it's Lunar Lake, 68Wh is quite small for a 16" laptop with a 3K OLED (OLED laptop panels guzzle power), so don't expect the outstanding battery life you usually get from lunar lake chips.
[Dunnomuch] It's adequate. As long as you don't crank the screen to Max brightness you'll get at least 8 hours doig light stuff or watching YouTube. Much less playing minecraft
[SiliconeFries] Decent screen on this contraption. 400 nits for SDR content and ramps up to 500 nits for HDR content
[Mokr] The HP OmniBook X Flip 16 weighs 1.88 kg (
Too heavy
[Kanjus] What exactly are you expecting for 16 incher?
[pn] https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/365881134992
Omnibook 7 14" 225H 32GB/512GB at $1300 seems to be a good deal as well, if you want something more portable. The colour, though.
[Raj09] I tried 14in screen before but it's hard to work on these. Ever tried opening and analysing a spreadsheet on a 14incb screen?
[BBKKLL] HP = hinge problem, and it’s not covered by warranty.
[JoeBogan] Will never buy HP again, bought an older version of the omnibook and had wifi issues after a few months of use. The back and forth with the utterly useless customer service reps was infuriating. Took over a month to get my refund after numerous calls and back and forth emails to customer service. Never again.
[stingyindian] I have a thinkpad x1 titanium yoga and been pretty happy with it for 4 yrs. It's nearing end of its life.
Any pros who know both can tell if this will be a good successor in terms of the life i can expect on the same lines?
[dlovep] The Good: Company paid for it…
The Bad: Well.. the hinges will go first on this flop book, once happen either left or right lower part of screen will crack like firework, lost touch screen along crack side of the screen, if you try to close it you lost that part of screen too.
Happened around 2 years when normal use, drop once or twice instant crack. Last quote was $6-700ish for screen replacement even under warranty.
[Raj09] Bloody hell! I'll get extra warranty.. Thanks for heads up
[didactw] I bought an omnibook x in the previous ebay deals. There were multiple hardware issues out of box like faulty webcam and internal clock. Been a month and they still have not repaired it, citing lack of spare parts because these are usually end of life. Had to go to consumer affairs for them to finally organise a return. Having being used to Dell's customer service, this whole experience has been a joke.
There's no one case manager or process handling the return, like returns are a shock to them. Had to explain the entire situation each time I called, chat or emailed.
Will not buy anything from HP again. Even Aliexpress has better customer service.
[Raj09] I'll see when I get the laptop. Hopefully it's a good one.
